newsitem.title: USA: Orphan Medical gets $1.3 mln in grants.
newsitem.headline: Orphan Medical gets $1.3 mln in grants.

text.p: Orphan Medical Inc said Wednesday it won more than $1.3 million in grants to support four of its development projects.

The grants extend over one to three years and cover certain project development activities. Three of the grants were made by the Food and Drug Administration's Office of Orphan Products Development. A fourth was made by the Small Business Administration's Small Business Innovation Research program.

The company is studying Busulfanex for use as a preparatory drug in bone marrow transplants, Colomed for treating chronic rectal inflammation after radiation and Antizol as an antidote for antifreeze poisoning. Intrachol is being developed for preventing and treating choline deficiency.
